background_setting: A straight, flat two-lane rural or suburban road stretching directly toward the horizon at sunset. The low sun sits just above the vanishing point of the road, flooding the entire upper and central portion of the frame with intense golden-white glare. Lane markings, road edges, and the shapes of vehicles ahead are washed out into a bright haze. Faint outlines of roadside features - utility poles, sparse trees, and a low horizon line - are dimly perceptible at the frame's edges where the glare is less overwhelming. The asphalt surface is a muted grey-brown, partially bleached by reflected sunlight.
